WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT SUM(cnt) as total_cnt FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT 
    step1.observstation,
    step1.cnt,
    CAST(step1.cnt AS REAL) / step2.total_cnt as proportion
  FROM step1, step2
  WHERE step2.total_cnt IS NOT NULL
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT AVG(proportion) as avg_proportion FROM step3
),
step5 AS (
  SELECT 
    step3.observstation,
    step3.cnt,
    step3.proportion,
    step3.proportion - step4.avg_proportion as diff
  FROM step3, step4
  WHERE step3.proportion > step4.avg_proportion
)
SELECT 
  SUM(cnt) as sum_cnt,
  AVG(proportion) as avg_proportion,
  AVG(diff) as avg_diff
FROM step5
